# NIC.IO
> The official .IO domain registry and Network Information Centre for .IO domain registration, WHOIS, policies, and support.

NIC.IO provides the core registry information and customer-facing resources for .IO domains, including domain purchase, WHOIS lookup, registry services, support documentation, and legal and policy materials.

## Registry and Domain Services
- [Home](https://nic.io/index.htm): Main registry homepage with .IO domain overview, navigation, and purchasing entry points.
- [Purchase Domain](https://nic.io/new.htm): Start a new .IO domain registration and add domains to your cart.
- [WHOIS Search](https://nic.io/whois-search.htm): Search .IO domain registration records and availability information.
- [Services](https://nic.io/services.htm): Overview of registry-related services and domain management offerings.

## Support
- [Support Center](https://nic.io/faq.htm): Frequently asked questions covering .IO domains, registration, and account support.
- [Contact](https://nic.io/contact.htm): Contact information for reaching NIC.IO regarding registry and support matters.
- [Sitemap](https://nic.io/sitemap.htm): Structured index of site pages for quickly locating registry resources.

## Policies and Legal
- [Terms & Conditions](https://nic.io/terms.htm): Legal terms governing use of NIC.IO services and domain registrations.
- [Allocation Rules](https://nic.io/rules.htm): Rules describing how .IO domains are allocated and administered.
- [Policies](https://nic.io/policy.htm): Registry policy documents and operational requirements for .IO domains.

## Domain Registration Information
- [Purchase Domain](https://nic.io/new.htm): Registration workflow for securing a .IO domain on a first-come basis.
- [Home](https://nic.io/index.htm): Explains .IO domains, intended use cases, and general registration context.
- [WHOIS Search](https://nic.io/whois-search.htm): Verify domain status before registering or managing a .IO name.

## Site Navigation
- [Home](https://nic.io/index.htm): Return to the main NIC.IO landing page and registry overview.
- [Services](https://nic.io/services.htm): Access service information related to .IO domain operations.
- [Support Center](https://nic.io/faq.htm): Find help resources and answers to common registry questions.
- [Sitemap](https://nic.io/sitemap.htm): Browse all major pages available on the NIC.IO website.

## External Registrar
- [Name.com](https://name.com): External registrar link referenced by NIC.IO for domain-related services.
